d: Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.
Join HealthHub's New Community Healthcare Clinic in Dubailand
HealthHub Clinics, part of Al-Futtaim Health, is seeking an experienced Registered Nurse to join our multidisciplinary team at our new HealthHub clinic in Dubailand.

Located within one of Dubai's growing residential areas, our new clinic will provide an exciting opportunity to support the healthcare needs of patients and families living in Dubailand and surrounding communities.
We are looking for a Registered Nurse who is passionate about delivering safe, compassionate and patient-centred care and who enjoys working within a busy outpatient healthcare environment.

This is an excellent opportunity for a nurse looking for a supportive clinical environment, a 5-day working week and long-term career development within Al-Futtaim Health. The five-day proposition is consistent with your existing internal nursing advert. Registered Nurse Generic
As a Registered Nurse, you will play a key role in supporting physicians and patients while delivering safe, effective and compassionate nursing care.

You will support the day-to-day delivery of high-quality outpatient healthcare services, including patient assessment, clinical procedures, medication administration, patient education and clinical documentation.
q: DHA Registered Nurse licence or DHA Eligibility Letter.
Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Nursing.
Previous nursing experience within an outpatient clinic, medical centre, ambulatory care or hospital environment.
Good Computer Skills And Experience With Clinical Documentation.

Ability to commute daily to Dubailand, Dubai.

Strong venepuncture and IV cannulation skills.

Experience working with a diverse patient population.

Al-Futtaim Health is the healthcare division of the Al-Futtaim Group, delivering integrated, community-based healthcare across the UAE. Through its HealthHub network, Al-Futtaim Health operates more than 12 clinics across Dubai, supported by a Day Surgery Centre, Al-Futtaim Health Labs, pharmacy, home healthcare, and digital health services.

With more than 25 medical specialties and a multidisciplinary team of over 150 specialist physicians and healthcare professionals, Al-Futtaim Health is committed to delivering high-quality, accessible healthcare while advancing innovation, preventive care, and clinical excellence.

As part of the Al-Futtaim Group, with a legacy spanning more than 90 years, Al-Futtaim Health offers the opportunity to build a meaningful career within one of the region's most respected and diversified businesses. Our people are empowered to grow, innovate, and make a positive impact on the health and wellbeing of the communities we serve.
